description: Returns the exact values accepted by the filters of search_coworking_spaces — amenity slugs, workspace types, operators and the observed price and capacity ranges — each with the number of spaces it would match in the current context. Amenity slugs use underscores, for example "ac_heating" and "free_coffee_tea", and cannot be guessed reliably, so call this before filtering by amenity. Pass a city to get counts and ranges for that city rather than the whole catalogue.

city.description: City slug, to scope counts and price ranges to one city.

country.description: Country slug, to scope to one country.

locale.description: Language for names and descriptions. Set from the user's language: 'de' for German, 'es' for Spanish, otherwise 'en'.

operator.description: Operator slug, to scope to one brand.

zone.description: Zone slug, to scope further to one district. Requires the city it belongs to.
